description: The Tempest block — Tempest (1997), Stronghold (1998) and Exodus (1998): 621 distinct cards and 636 original English printings, 574 of them new to the game.
name: The Tempest Block
rules_note: Original Tempest, Stronghold and Exodus artwork with current Oracle rules. The 42 cards the game already has keep their existing scripts; the 27 of them that live only in Ice Age, Portal, Portal Second Age or Mirage are provided by this pack too when that pack is off.
